d: Today we meet Sara, searching for her dream home in Silicon Valley. With her friend JP, she tours three incredible properties with Viviana. Hoping to seize the moment and get the right home at the right price, will Sara find exactly what she's looking for?

In this episode we meet Cory. Cory is looking to surprise his wife with their dream home. Viviana takes him through three properties in Los Angeles, California. Cory and his wife need enough room to grow their family. Will they find the perfect family home?

In this episode, Viviana helps Win find his ultimate dream home. We travel around Santa Barbara, California in search of a tranquil home in the middle of nature. He needs a peaceful house where he can host his family.
We meet married couple Henri and Chris, who are in search of a luxury desert home. They need a house with modern conveniences to entertain in.
In this episode, we meet John and Laura who are in search of a luxury home. Viviana is taking them through some of the most beautiful mega mansions in Montecito, California.

Today we meet Rami, who wants to surprise his fiancé with a brand new home. Viviana takes him through three wonderful homes in Silicon Valley, California. Rami is looking for a home with a great view where he can build a family. Will we be able to help him find the perfect home?
Bobbi Jo & Carmen are upgrading in the Hollywood Hills. Will one of three luxe Los Angeles properties become their dream home?
Crown Prince of Palm Springs, Fleet Easton, is ready to buy his dream desert home. Which of these dazzling desert digs will he choose?
Patrick & Pol are on a Million Dollar Malibu House Hunt. From sleek modern to classic charm—will one of these homes check all the boxes?
Leanne & Michael want a coastal home now that the kids are grown. Will one of three Orange County sea-side sanctuaries be the one?
Talia and Ricarda tour Westwood and Century City, uncovering luxurious condos and prestigious estates in pursuit of their million-dollar dream residence.

Today is all about Candice, who is looking for the perfect home for her and her new husband. Viviana takes her through three incredible homes in Los Gatos, California. Candice is looking to build a family in her forever home. Will she find what she is looking for?
Glen and Giovanna return to Calabasas, determined to secure their ideal home in an enclave of luxury and privacy. Will they finally find their home in Calabasas?
Today's episode is all about Jim and Cheryl. Jim and Cheryl are looking to retire into their dream home close to their family. Will Encino CA have what they are after?
